sections.title: Background

summary.text: Defines digital health and explains that guidelines are usually narrative, so translating them into digital systems is costly and inconsistent, and system content is often undocumented or proprietary. It introduces digital adaptation kits as a way to package WHO recommendations into standard, transparent requirements within the SMART Guidelines approach. It also explains digital tracking and decision support and the stages from paper to smart digital systems.

sections.title: Objectives

summary.text: Sets out the objectives of the antenatal care digital adaptation kit: providing a shared language for programme managers, developers and implementers and ensuring digital tracking and decision-support systems follow WHO guidance. It notes links to other kits, including a forthcoming one on self-care.

sections.extract: This DAK focuses on antenatal care (ANC) and aims to provide a common language across various audiences – maternal health and other programme managers, software developers, and implementers of digital systems – to ensure a common understanding of the appropriate health information content within the ANC health programme area, as a mechanism to catalyse the effective use of these digital systems. sections.title: Components of a digital adaptation kit

summary.text: Describes the eight interlinked components of the digital adaptation kit, from health interventions and recommendations, personas and user scenarios to workflows, core data elements, decision-support logic, indicators and functional requirements. A table explains the purpose, outputs and adaptation needed for each component. It also notes the kit builds on PATH's work on maternal health information system requirements and explains naming conventions for requirement identifiers.

sections.extract: The DAK comprises eight interlinked components: (1) health interventions and associated recommendations; (2) generic personas; (3) user scenarios; (4) generic business processes and workflows; (5) core data elements; (6) decision-support logic; (7) indicators and reporting requirements; and (8) high- level functional and non-functional requirements. sections.title: How to use this digital adaptation kit

summary.text: Identifies the main audience as ministry of health programme managers working with digital and information system teams, along with business analysts who translate guidance into system requirements. It describes the modular design linked to other health areas and scenarios for use, such as checking existing systems against WHO content or building a new point-of-care client record. It also explains terminology such as the use of "client" and "woman".

sections.title: Linkages to the broader digital health ecosystem

summary.text: A very long section covering most of the antenatal care digital adaptation kit, opening with how such kits fit into the wider digital health ecosystem and a seven-phase planning process. It lists the antenatal care interventions drawn from WHO's universal health coverage compendium and the WHO guidelines the kit reflects, including those on antenatal care, tuberculosis screening, HIV, malaria and syphilis. Its later parts set out the kit's components, such as personas, workflows, data elements, decision logic and indicators. It ends with annex guidance on filling in a data dictionary, including required fields, skip logic, links to aggregate indicators and concept mappings to ICD-11 or SNOMED.

narratives.en: Grid under the banner 'During pregnancy (Antenatal care)' showing, with green check marks and red crosses, which health worker cadres may deliver selected interventions: promotion of maternal, newborn and reproductive health interventions; misoprostol distribution (no recommendation, research needed); oral supplement distribution; low-dose aspirin distribution; and diagnosis and initial treatment of pPROM using injectable antibiotics. Most cadres have check marks, while lay health workers are crossed for aspirin and pPROM, and auxiliary nurses and auxiliary nurse midwives for pPROM.
narratives.ar: شبكة تحت عنوان 'During pregnancy (Antenatal care)' تبين، بعلامات صح خضراء وعلامات خطأ حمراء، فئات العاملين الصحيين التي يمكنها تقديم تدخلات مختارة: تعزيز تدخلات صحة الأم والوليد والصحة الإنجابية؛ وتوزيع الميزوبروستول (لا توصية، يلزم البحث)؛ وتوزيع المكملات الفموية؛ وتوزيع الأسبرين بجرعة منخفضة؛ وتشخيص تمزق الأغشية المبكر قبل الأوان (pPROM) وعلاجه الأولي بالمضادات الحيوية بالحقن. معظم الفئات تحمل علامات صح، بينما يحمل العاملون الصحيون غير المتخصصين علامات خطأ للأسبرين وpPROM، والممرضون المساعدون والقابلات الممرضات المساعدات لـ pPROM.
narratives.zh: “During pregnancy (Antenatal care)”标题下的网格，用绿色对勾和红色叉号显示哪些卫生工作者类别可提供选定干预措施：促进孕产妇、新生儿和生殖健康干预；米索前列醇分发（未提出建议，需要研究）；口服补充剂分发；低剂量阿司匹林分发；以及使用注射用抗生素诊断和初步治疗早产胎膜早破（pPROM）。大多数类别为对勾，而非专业卫生工作者在阿司匹林和pPROM项为叉号，助理护士和助理护士助产士在pPROM项为叉号。
narratives.es: Cuadrícula bajo el título «During pregnancy (Antenatal care)» que indica, con marcas verdes y cruces rojas, qué categorías de trabajadores de la salud pueden prestar determinadas intervenciones: promoción de intervenciones de salud materna, neonatal y reproductiva; distribución de misoprostol (sin recomendación, se requiere investigación); distribución de suplementos orales; distribución de aspirina en dosis bajas; y diagnóstico y tratamiento inicial de la RPMP con antibióticos inyectables. La mayoría de las categorías tienen marcas de verificación, mientras que los trabajadores de salud legos tienen cruces para la aspirina y la RPMP, y los auxiliares de enfermería y las enfermeras parteras auxiliares para la RPMP.
narratives.fr: Grille sous le bandeau « During pregnancy (Antenatal care) » indiquant, par des coches vertes et des croix rouges, quelles catégories d'agents de santé peuvent fournir certaines interventions : promotion des interventions de santé maternelle, néonatale et reproductive ; distribution de misoprostol (aucune recommandation, recherche nécessaire) ; distribution de suppléments oraux ; distribution d'aspirine à faible dose ; et diagnostic et traitement initial de la RPMP par antibiotiques injectables. La plupart des catégories ont des coches, tandis que les agents de santé non professionnels ont des croix pour l'aspirine et la RPMP, et les infirmiers auxiliaires et infirmières sages-femmes auxiliaires pour la RPMP.
narratives.ru: Таблица под заголовком «During pregnancy (Antenatal care)», где зелеными галочками и красными крестиками показано, какие категории медработников могут выполнять отдельные вмешательства: продвижение вмешательств в области охраны здоровья матерей, новорожденных и репродуктивного здоровья; раздача мизопростола (рекомендации нет, нужны исследования); раздача пероральных добавок; раздача низких доз аспирина; диагностика и начальное лечение ПДИВ инъекционными антибиотиками. У большинства категорий стоят галочки, тогда как у непрофессиональных медработников — крестики для аспирина и ПДИВ, а у младших медсестер и младших медсестер-акушерок — для ПДИВ.

Le couloir de la communauté contient D. Promotion de la santé en soins prénatals.
narratives.ru: Верхняя часть диаграммы с дорожками основных процессов дородовой помощи (рисунок 5). На дорожке «Медицинское учреждение»: Начало → A. Регистрация → «Нужно направление?» (Да → D. Направление; Нет → B. Дородовой визит) → «Нужно направление?» (Да → D. Направление; Нет → Оплата, серым) → Конец. На дорожке «Сообщество» — D. Пропаганда здоровья в рамках дородовой помощи.

narratives.en: Bottom lane of the ANC processes diagram (Fig. 5), labelled 'Health facility management', containing three sub-process boxes: Configuration, Follow-up (greyed) and Aggregate reporting.
narratives.ar: المسار السفلي من مخطط عمليات رعاية الحوامل (الشكل 5)، بعنوان 'إدارة المرفق الصحي'، ويتضمن ثلاثة مربعات لعمليات فرعية: التهيئة، والمتابعة (باللون الرمادي)، والإبلاغ الإجمالي.
narratives.zh: 产前保健流程图（图5）的底部泳道，标为“卫生机构管理”，包含三个子流程框：配置、随访（灰色）和汇总报告。
narratives.es: Carril inferior del diagrama de procesos de atención prenatal (figura 5), titulado «Gestión del establecimiento de salud», con tres recuadros de subprocesos: Configuración, Seguimiento (en gris) e Informes agregados.
narratives.fr: Couloir inférieur du diagramme des processus de soins prénatals (figure 5), intitulé « Gestion de l'établissement de santé », contenant trois cases de sous-processus : Configuration, Suivi (en gris) et Rapports agrégés.
narratives.ru: Нижняя дорожка диаграммы процессов дородовой помощи (рисунок 5) «Управление медицинским учреждением» с тремя блоками подпроцессов: Настройка, Последующее наблюдение (серым) и Сводная отчетность.

narratives.en: Page render with Fig. 6, 'Workflow: Registration business process', a swimlane diagram (Client; Health worker or Clerk) whose objective is to identify and register a pregnant woman. Steps run from 1. Arrive at facility, 2. Rapid assessment and management (RAM) and 3. 'Urgent referral necessary?' (Yes → C. ANC referral) through gathering and searching for client details, 'Match found?' (No → 7. Create client record; Yes → 8. Validate client details), to 9. Check-in client and B. ANC contact.
narratives.ar: صفحة مصيّرة تتضمن الشكل 6، 'Workflow: Registration business process'، وهو مخطط مسارات (العميلة؛ العامل الصحي أو الموظف) هدفه تحديد هوية المرأة الحامل وتسجيلها. تمتد الخطوات من 1. الوصول إلى المرفق، و2. التقييم والتدبير السريع (RAM)، و3. 'هل الإحالة العاجلة ضرورية؟' (نعم ← C. إحالة رعاية الحوامل)، مرورًا بجمع بيانات العميلة والبحث عنها، و'هل وُجد تطابق؟' (لا ← 7. إنشاء سجل العميلة؛ نعم ← 8. التحقق من بيانات العميلة)، وصولًا إلى 9. تسجيل وصول العميلة وB. زيارة رعاية الحوامل.
narratives.zh: 页面渲染图，含图6“Workflow: Registration business process”，这是一个泳道图（服务对象；卫生工作者或文员），目标是识别并登记孕妇。步骤从1. 到达机构、2. 快速评估和处理（RAM）、3. “需要紧急转诊？”（是 → C. 产前保健转诊），经收集和搜索服务对象信息、“找到匹配？”（否 → 7. 创建服务对象记录；是 → 8. 核实服务对象信息），到9. 服务对象签到和B. 产前保健接触。
narratives.es: Representación de la página con la figura 6, «Workflow: Registration business process», un diagrama de carriles (Cliente; Trabajador de la salud o empleado) cuyo objetivo es identificar y registrar a una embarazada. Los pasos van de 1. Llegada al establecimiento, 2. Evaluación y manejo rápidos (RAM) y 3. «¿Es necesaria una derivación urgente?» (Sí → C. Derivación de atención prenatal), pasando por la recopilación y búsqueda de los datos de la clienta y «¿Se encontró coincidencia?» (No → 7. Crear registro; Sí → 8. Validar datos), hasta 9. Registro de entrada y B. Contacto de atención prenatal.
narratives.fr: Rendu de page avec la figure 6, « Workflow: Registration business process », un diagramme en couloirs (Cliente ; Agent de santé ou employé) dont l'objectif est d'identifier et d'enregistrer une femme enceinte. Les étapes vont de 1. Arrivée à l'établissement, 2. Évaluation et prise en charge rapides (RAM) et 3. « Orientation urgente nécessaire ? » (Oui → C. Orientation en soins prénatals), en passant par la collecte et la recherche des données de la cliente et « Correspondance trouvée ? » (Non → 7. Créer un dossier ; Oui → 8. Valider les données), jusqu'à 9. Enregistrement de l'arrivée et B. Contact de soins prénatals.
narratives.ru: Изображение страницы с рисунком 6 «Workflow: Registration business process» — диаграммой с дорожками (Клиент; Медработник или регистратор), цель которой — идентифицировать и зарегистрировать беременную женщину. Шаги: 1. Прибытие в учреждение, 2. Быстрая оценка и ведение (RAM), 3. «Нужно срочное направление?» (Да → C. Направление в рамках дородовой помощи), далее сбор и поиск данных клиента, «Совпадение найдено?» (Нет → 7. Создать запись; Да → 8. Проверить данные), затем 9. Регистрация прихода клиента и B. Дородовой визит.

narratives.en: Page render with Fig. 9, 'Workflow: ANC health promotion follow-up in the community', a swimlane diagram (Woman; Community health worker). The worker plans routine, targeted community support, visits the woman and does a quick check; if danger signs need referral, the path goes to 5. Referral and ends, otherwise to 6. ANC case management in the community, 7. Schedule next visit and 8. Self-care interventions in the home or community.
narratives.ar: صفحة مصيّرة تتضمن الشكل 9، 'Workflow: ANC health promotion follow-up in the community'، وهو مخطط مسارات (المرأة؛ العامل الصحي المجتمعي). يخطط العامل للدعم المجتمعي الروتيني الموجه، ويزور المرأة ويجري فحصًا سريعًا؛ وإذا وُجدت علامات خطر تستدعي الإحالة ينتقل المسار إلى 5. الإحالة وينتهي، وإلا إلى 6. إدارة حالة رعاية الحوامل في المجتمع، و7. تحديد موعد الزيارة التالية، و8. تدخلات الرعاية الذاتية في المنزل أو المجتمع.
narratives.zh: 页面渲染图，含图9“Workflow: ANC health promotion follow-up in the community”，这是一个泳道图（妇女；社区卫生工作者）。工作者计划常规的、有针对性的社区支持，探访妇女并进行快速检查；如有需要转诊的危险征象，则进入5. 转诊并结束，否则进入6. 社区产前保健病例管理、7. 安排下次访视和8. 家庭或社区自我保健干预。
narratives.es: Representación de la página con la figura 9, «Workflow: ANC health promotion follow-up in the community», un diagrama de carriles (Mujer; Agente de salud comunitario). El agente planifica el apoyo comunitario rutinario y focalizado, visita a la mujer y hace una comprobación rápida; si hay signos de peligro que requieren derivación, el flujo pasa a 5. Derivación y termina; de lo contrario, a 6. Gestión de casos de atención prenatal en la comunidad, 7. Programar la siguiente visita y 8. Intervenciones de autocuidado en el hogar o la comunidad.
narratives.fr: Rendu de page avec la figure 9, « Workflow: ANC health promotion follow-up in the community », un diagramme en couloirs (Femme ; Agent de santé communautaire). L'agent planifie un soutien communautaire régulier et ciblé, rend visite à la femme et effectue une vérification rapide ; en présence de signes de danger nécessitant une orientation, le flux passe à 5. Orientation et se termine, sinon à 6. Prise en charge des cas de soins prénatals dans la communauté, 7. Planifier la visite suivante et 8. Interventions d'autosoins à domicile ou dans la communauté.
narratives.ru: Изображение страницы с рисунком 9 «Workflow: ANC health promotion follow-up in the community» — диаграммой с дорожками (Женщина; Общинный медработник). Медработник планирует регулярную адресную поддержку на уровне сообщества, посещает женщину и проводит быструю проверку; при опасных признаках, требующих направления, процесс переходит к 5. Направление и завершается, иначе — к 6. Ведение случая дородовой помощи в сообществе, 7. Назначение следующего визита и 8. Меры самопомощи дома или в сообществе.

narratives.en: Page render with Fig. 10, 'Reporting on aggregate indicators', a swimlane diagram with lanes for facility staff, facility in-charge and district health officer/staff. Facility staff check data quality, correct issues, generate and check aggregate reports; the in-charge may review the report and provide feedback before data are submitted electronically; the district officer reviews submitted data and either ends the process or provides feedback to the facility.
narratives.ar: صفحة مصيّرة تتضمن الشكل 10، 'Reporting on aggregate indicators'، وهو مخطط مسارات لموظفي المرفق ومسؤول المرفق ومسؤول/موظفي الصحة في المنطقة. يتحقق موظفو المرفق من جودة البيانات، ويصححون المشكلات، وينشئون التقارير الإجمالية ويراجعونها؛ وقد يراجع المسؤول التقرير ويقدم ملاحظات قبل تقديم البيانات إلكترونيًا؛ ويراجع مسؤول المنطقة البيانات المقدمة وإما ينهي العملية أو يقدم ملاحظات إلى المرفق.
narratives.zh: 页面渲染图，含图10“Reporting on aggregate indicators”，这是一个泳道图，泳道为机构工作人员、机构负责人和地区卫生官员/工作人员。机构工作人员检查数据质量、纠正问题、生成并检查汇总报告；负责人可审阅报告并反馈，之后以电子方式提交数据；地区官员审阅提交的数据，然后结束流程或向机构提供反馈。
narratives.es: Representación de la página con la figura 10, «Reporting on aggregate indicators», un diagrama de carriles para el personal del establecimiento, el responsable del establecimiento y el funcionario/personal de salud del distrito. El personal comprueba la calidad de los datos, corrige los problemas y genera y verifica los informes agregados; el responsable puede revisar el informe y dar retroalimentación antes de que los datos se envíen electrónicamente; el funcionario del distrito revisa los datos enviados y concluye el proceso o da retroalimentación al establecimiento.
narratives.fr: Rendu de page avec la figure 10, « Reporting on aggregate indicators », un diagramme en couloirs pour le personnel de l'établissement, le responsable de l'établissement et l'agent/le personnel de santé du district. Le personnel vérifie la qualité des données, corrige les problèmes, génère et contrôle les rapports agrégés ; le responsable peut examiner le rapport et formuler des observations avant la transmission électronique des données ; l'agent de district examine les données transmises et clôt le processus ou formule des observations à l'établissement.
narratives.ru: Изображение страницы с рисунком 10 «Reporting on aggregate indicators» — диаграммой с дорожками для персонала учреждения, руководителя учреждения и районного медицинского специалиста/персонала. Персонал проверяет качество данных, исправляет ошибки, формирует и проверяет сводные отчеты; руководитель может проверить отчет и дать обратную связь до электронной передачи данных; районный специалист проверяет поступившие данные и либо завершает процесс, либо направляет обратную связь в учреждение.

narratives.en: Page render with Fig. 11, 'Examples of decision trees to supplement decision-support tables'. The left tree, 'Quick Check', splits into Danger Sign (e.g. unconscious, convulsing, bleeding vaginally, severe abdominal pain, fever, labour), leading to transfer for Rapid Assessment and Management (RAM), or No Danger Sign, leading to routine care. The right tree, 'Antenatal registration: provider-initiated HIV testing & counselling', branches into HIV-positive and HIV-negative pathways covering partner testing, risk assessment, HIV prevention options and initiation of PrEP.
narratives.ar: صفحة مصيّرة تتضمن الشكل 11، 'Examples of decision trees to supplement decision-support tables'. تتفرع الشجرة اليسرى 'الفحص السريع' إلى وجود علامة خطر (مثل فقدان الوعي، والتشنج، والنزيف المهبلي، وألم البطن الشديد، والحمى، والمخاض) تؤدي إلى النقل للتقييم والتدبير السريع (RAM)، أو عدم وجود علامة خطر تؤدي إلى الرعاية الروتينية. وتتفرع الشجرة اليمنى 'تسجيل رعاية الحوامل: اختبار فيروس العوز المناعي البشري والمشورة بمبادرة من مقدم الخدمة' إلى مساري إيجابية وسلبية الفيروس، وتشمل اختبار الشريك وتقييم المخاطر وخيارات الوقاية من الفيروس وبدء العلاج الوقائي قبل التعرض (PrEP).
narratives.zh: 页面渲染图，含图11“Examples of decision trees to supplement decision-support tables”。左侧决策树“快速检查”分为有危险征象（如意识丧失、抽搐、阴道出血、严重腹痛、发热、临产），转入快速评估和处理（RAM），或无危险征象，进入常规保健。右侧决策树“产前登记：医务人员主动提供的艾滋病毒检测和咨询”分为艾滋病毒阳性和阴性路径，涵盖性伴检测、风险评估、艾滋病毒预防选项和开始暴露前预防（PrEP）。
narratives.es: Representación de la página con la figura 11, «Examples of decision trees to supplement decision-support tables». El árbol izquierdo, «Comprobación rápida», se divide en Signo de peligro (p. ej., inconsciencia, convulsiones, sangrado vaginal, dolor abdominal intenso, fiebre, trabajo de parto), que lleva al traslado para Evaluación y Manejo Rápidos (RAM), o Sin signo de peligro, que lleva a la atención de rutina. El árbol derecho, «Registro prenatal: pruebas y asesoramiento sobre el VIH por iniciativa del proveedor», se ramifica en vías para VIH positivo y VIH negativo que abarcan la prueba de la pareja, la evaluación del riesgo, las opciones de prevención del VIH y el inicio de la PrEP.
narratives.fr: Rendu de page avec la figure 11, « Examples of decision trees to supplement decision-support tables ». L'arbre de gauche, « Vérification rapide », se divise en Signe de danger (par ex. inconscience, convulsions, saignement vaginal, douleur abdominale intense, fièvre, travail), menant au transfert pour évaluation et prise en charge rapides (RAM), ou Absence de signe de danger, menant aux soins de routine. L'arbre de droite, « Enregistrement prénatal : dépistage et conseil à l'initiative du soignant pour le VIH », se ramifie en parcours VIH positif et VIH négatif couvrant le dépistage du partenaire, l'évaluation des risques, les options de prévention du VIH et l'initiation de la PrEP.
narratives.ru: Изображение страницы с рисунком 11 «Examples of decision trees to supplement decision-support tables». Левое дерево «Быстрая проверка» разделяется на «Опасный признак» (например, потеря сознания, судороги, вагинальное кровотечение, сильная боль в животе, лихорадка, роды), ведущий к переводу для быстрой оценки и ведения (RAM), и «Нет опасных признаков», ведущий к плановой помощи. Правое дерево «Регистрация в дородовой помощи: тестирование и консультирование по ВИЧ по инициативе медработника» разветвляется на пути для ВИЧ-положительных и ВИЧ-отрицательных, включая тестирование партнера, оценку риска, варианты профилактики ВИЧ и начало ДКП.

narratives.ar: صورة لعدة سجلات ورقية ودفاتر سجلات زرقاء ذات أغلفة صلبة على مكتب، وأحد السجلات الكبيرة مفتوح على إدخالات جدولية مكتوبة بخط اليد.

narratives.es: Foto de varios registros de papel y libros de registro azules de tapa dura sobre un escritorio, con un gran registro abierto que muestra entradas manuscritas en forma de tabla.
narratives.fr: Photo de plusieurs registres papier et cahiers d'enregistrement bleus à couverture rigide sur un bureau, dont un grand registre ouvert sur des entrées manuscrites en tableau.

tables.caption: Table 1. Components of a digital adaptation kit
rows: Overview of the health interventions and WHO recommendations included within this digital adaptation kit (DAK). DAKs are meant to be a repackaging and integration of WHO guidelines and guidance documents in a particular health domain. The list of health interventions is drawn from the universal health coverage (UHC) menu of interventions compiled by WHO (14).
Setting the stage – To understand how this DAK would be applied to a digital tracking and decision-support system in the context of specific health programmes and interventions
» List of related health interventions based on WHO’s UHC essential interventions » List of related WHO recommendations based on guidelines and guidance documents
» Contextualization to reflect current or planned national policies

Depiction of the end-users, supervisors and related stakeholders who would be interacting with the digital system or involved in the care pathway. A local adaptation of the personas should contain high-level information to describe the provider of the health service (e.g. the general background, roles and responsibilities, motivations, challenges, and environmental factors).
Contextualization – To understand the wants, needs and constraints of the end-users
» Description, competencies and essential interventions performed by targeted personas
» Greater specification and details on the end-users based on real people (i.e. health workers) in a given context
Narratives that describe how the different personas may interact with each other. The user scenarios are only illustrative and intended to give an idea of a typical workflow.
Contextualization – To understand how the system would be used, and how it would fit into existing workflows
» Example narrative of how the targeted personas may interact with each other during a workflow
» Greater specification and details on the real needs of end-users in a given context

A business process is a set of related activities or tasks performed together to achieve the objectives of the health programme area, such as registration, counselling, referrals (1,15). Workflows are a visual representation of the progression of activities (tasks, decision points, interactions) that are performed within the business process (1,16).
Contextualization and system design – To understand how the digital system would fit into existing workflows and how best to design the system for that purpose
» Overview matrix presenting the key processes in antenatal care (ANC) » Workflows for identified business processes with annotations
» Customization of the workflows that can include additional forks, alternative pathways or entirely new workflows

Data elements required throughout the different points of the workflow. These data elements are mapped to the International Classification of Diseases version 11 (ICD-11) codes and other established concept mapping standards to ensure the data dictionary is compatible with other digital systems.

System design and interoperability – To know which data elements need to be logged and how they map to other standard terminologies (e.g. ICD, Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine [SNOMED]) for interoperability with other standards-based systems
» List of data elements » Link to data dictionary with detailed data specifications in spreadsheet format (see Web Annex A).
» Translation of “data labels” into the local language and additional data elements created depending on the context
Decision-support logic and algorithms to support appropriate service delivery in accordance with WHO clinical, public health and data use guidelines.
System design and adherence to recommended clinical practice – To know what underlying logic needs to be coded into the system

» List of decisions that need to be made throughout the encounter » Link to decision-support tables in a spreadsheet format with inputs, outputs and triggers for each decision-support logic (see Web Annex B) » Scheduling logic for services

» Change of specific thresholds or triggers in a logic (IF/THEN) statement, e.g. body mass index (BMI) cut-off, age trigger for “youth friendly” services » Additional decision-support logic formulas depending on the context

Core set of indicators that need to be aggregated for decision-making, performance metrics, and subnational and national reporting. These indicators and metrics are based on data that can feasibly be captured from a routine digital system, rather than survey-based tools.

System design and adherence to recommended health monitoring practices – To know what calculations and secondary data use is needed for the system, based on the principle of “collect once, use many” (10)

rows: Auxiliary nurse midwives (ANMs) assist in the provision of maternal and newborn health care, particularly during childbirth but also in the prenatal and postpartum periods. ANMs have some training in secondary school and a period of on-the-job training may be included, sometimes formalized in apprenticeships. Like an auxiliary nurse, an auxiliary nurse midwife has basic nursing skills but no training in nursing decision-making. They possess some competencies in midwifery but are not fully qualified as midwives (22).

A person who has been assessed and registered by a state midwifery regulatory authority or similar regulatory authority. They offer care to childbearing women during pregnancy, labour and birth, and during the postpartum period. They also care for the newborn and assist the mother with breastfeeding. Their education lasts three, four or more years in nursing school, and leads to a university or postgraduate university degree, or the equivalent. A registered midwife has the full range of midwifery skills (22).

A graduate who has been legally authorized (registered) to practise after examination by a state board of nurse examiners or similar regulatory authority. Education includes three, four or more years in nursing school, and leads to a university or postgraduate university degree, or the equivalent. A registered nurse has the full range of nursing skills.
Registered nurse, nurse practitioner, clinical nurse specialist, advance practice nurse, practice nurse, licensed nurse, diploma nurse, nurse clinician

rows: Pregnant women are the primary clients receiving antenatal care (ANC) services from the targeted health worker personas. tables.caption: Table 6. Business process symbols used in workflows
rows: A pool consists of multiple “swim lanes” that depict all the individuals or types of users that are involved in carrying out the business process or workflow. Diagrams should be clear, neat and easy for all viewers to understand the relationship across the different swim lanes. For example, a pool would depict the business process of conducting an outreach activity, which involves multiple stakeholders represented by different lanes in that pool.

Each individual or type of user is assigned to a swim lane, a designated area for noting the activities performed or expected by that specific actor. For example, an antenatal care health worker may have one swim lane; the supervisor would be in another swim lane; the clients/patients would be classified in another swim lane.
The workflow diagram should contain both a start and an end event, defining the beginning and completion of the task, respectively.
There can be multiple end events depicted across multiple swim lanes in a business process diagram. However, for diagram clarity, there should only be one end event per swim lane.

Each activity should start with a verb, e.g. “Register client”, “Calculate risk”. Between the start and end of a task, there should be a series of activities noting the successive actions performed by the actor in that swim lane. There can also be subprocesses within each activity.

This denotes an activity that has a much longer subprocess to be detailed in another diagram. If the diagram starts to become too complex and unhelpful, the subprocess symbol should be used to reference another process depicted on another page.

This denotes a decision-making activity that requires the business rule, or decision-support logic, to be detailed in a “decision-support table”. This means that the logic described in the decision-support table will come into play during this activity as outlined in the business process. This is usually reserved for complex decisions.

This denotes the flow direction from one process to the next. The end event should not have any output arrows. All symbols (except start event) may have an unlimited number of input arrows. All symbols (except end event and gateway) should have one and only one output arrow. All other symbols should have one output arrow leading to a new symbol, looping back to a previously used symbol or to the end event symbol. Connecting arrows should not intersect (cross) each other.
This denotes the flow of data or information from one process to another. This is usually used for when data are shared across swim lanes or stakeholder groups.

This symbol is used to depict a fork, or decision point, in the workflow, which may be a simple binary (e.g. yes/no) filter with two corresponding output arrows, or a different set of outputs. There should only be two different outputs that originate from the decision point. If you find yourself needing more than two “output” or sequence flow arrows, you most likely are trying to depict “decision-support logic” or a “business rule”. This should be depicted as an “Activity with business rule” (above) instead.

The “Throw – Link” serves as the start of an off-page connector. It is the end of the process when there is no more room on your page for that workflow. It is the end of a process on your current page or the end of a subprocess that is part of a larger process. There will need to be a “Catch – Link” that follows the “Throw – Link”.

The “Catch – Link” serves as the end of an off-page connector. It is the start of the new process on a different page from the “Throw – Link” or the start of a subprocess that is part of a larger process. There needs to be a “Throw – Link” that is aligned to the “Catch – Link”.

An ad hoc subprocess can contain multiple tasks. One or more tasks in this shape should be performed, and they can be performed in any order. However, not all of these activities need to be finished before moving on to the next activity.
tables.notes: Symbol column cells contain graphics only (pool/lane diagrams, circles, boxes, arrows, diamond, link icons); left empty in transcription.

narratives.es: El cuadro enumera los elementos de datos básicos que se registran en cada actividad de los procesos operativos de atención prenatal: registro (ANC.A), contacto prenatal (ANC.B) y derivación (ANC.C). narratives.zh: 本表列出了产前保健接触工作流程的38个决策支持表（ANC.DT.01–ANC.DT.38），按任务分组，如危险征象、实验室检查和影像、诊断和治疗、咨询以及免疫接种。对每个表，均给出了说明以及作为参考来源的世卫组织指南或指导手册。
narratives.es: El cuadro enumera las 38 tablas de apoyo a la toma de decisiones (ANC.DT.01–ANC.DT.38) del flujo de trabajo del contacto prenatal, agrupadas por tarea, como signos de peligro, pruebas de laboratorio e imagen, diagnóstico y tratamiento, asesoramiento e inmunización. rows: The name of the “decision” describing what algorithm or logic is represented (e.g. pre-eclampsia risk counselling). The Decision ID should correspond to the number in the overview table (Table 10).

The description of the decision that needs to be made based on IF/THEN statements with the appropriate data element name for the variables. The rule should demonstrate the relationship between the input variables and the expected outputs and actions within the decision-support logic – e.g. if blood pressure is higher than 140 SBP/90 DBP, then the client should be flagged as a high-risk pregnancy.
The event that would indicate when this decision-support logic should appear within the workflow, such as the activity that would trigger this decision to be made.

These are the variables or conditions that need to be considered to determine the consequent actions or outputs » If there are multiple input entries on the same row, these different inputs are considered as “AND” – conditions that need to be in place at the same time » Inputs placed on different rows are considered as “OR” conditions that can be considered independently of the inputs on other rows.

The resulting action or decision based on the combination of input entries. This is the statement that immediately follows the “THEN”. Examples of outputs may include a diagnosis, alerts/prompts for referral, and counselling.
Concrete measures to be taken based on the output (refer, provide treatment and/or counselling, conduct test, etc.). In some cases, output and action may be the same.

Additional explanations or descriptions, including possible pop-up alert messages and relevant background information. This section can also include the written content which would appear in the pop-up messages notifying the health worker on the appropriate next steps, which can include counselling, case management approach, or referral.

narratives.fr: Le tableau est un extrait de la table d’aide à la décision pour le diagnostic de la pré-éclampsie, de la pré-éclampsie sévère et de l’hypertension (ANC.DT.16), avec sa règle opérationnelle et son déclencheur. Quatre lignes combinent comme entrées les mesures de tension artérielle, l’absence de symptômes de pré-éclampsie sévère et les résultats de protéinurie, avec le résultat, l’action et une annotation destinée à l’agent de santé.
narratives.ru: Таблица представляет собой фрагмент таблицы поддержки принятия решений для диагностики преэклампсии, тяжёлой преэклампсии и гипертензии (ANC.DT.16) с указанием бизнес-правила и триггера. В четырёх строках в качестве входных данных сочетаются показатели артериального давления, отсутствие симптомов тяжёлой преэклампсии и результаты анализа мочи на белок, а также приводятся результат, действие и примечание для медицинского работника.

narratives.es: El cuadro ofrece una visión general de las cinco tablas de lógica de programación del kit de adaptación digital para la atención prenatal, que abarcan los contactos prenatales, las pruebas de laboratorio e imagen, el asesoramiento, las inmunizaciones y la profilaxis del paludismo. Para cada una indica el identificador, el nombre, la descripción y las referencias de la OMS en que se basa.
narratives.fr: Le tableau présente une vue d’ensemble des cinq tables de logique de planification du kit d’adaptation numérique pour les soins prénatals, portant sur les contacts prénatals, les examens de laboratoire et l’imagerie, le conseil, les vaccinations et la prophylaxie antipaludique. Pour chacune, il indique l’identifiant, le nom, la description et les références de l’OMS sur lesquelles elle repose.
narratives.ru: В таблице представлен обзор пяти таблиц логики составления графиков в наборе средств цифровой адаптации для дородовой помощи, охватывающих дородовые контакты, лабораторные исследования и визуализацию, консультирование, иммунизацию и профилактику малярии. Для каждой указаны идентификатор, название, описание и справочные материалы ВОЗ, на которых она основана.

narratives.es: El cuadro define 13 indicadores de atención prenatal (ANC.IND.1–13), entre ellos 3 indicadores específicos del contexto sobre el tratamiento preventivo intermitente del paludismo, la prueba del VIH y la PrEP oral. Para cada indicador indica la definición y el cálculo del numerador y del denominador, el desglose recomendado y la fuente de referencia.

Pour chaque indicateur, il donne la définition et le calcul du numérateur et du dénominateur, la ventilation recommandée et la source de référence.

narratives.en: The table lists 53 functional requirements (ANC.FXNREQ.001–053) for a digital antenatal care system, grouped by business process A (registration) and B (ANC contact). Each requirement is written as a user story giving the activity, the user role (“As a…”) and what that user wants the system to do.
narratives.ar: يسرد الجدول 53 متطلبًا وظيفيًا (ANC.FXNREQ.001–053) لنظام رقمي للرعاية السابقة للولادة، مجمعة حسب العملية التشغيلية A (التسجيل) وB (زيارة الرعاية السابقة للولادة). وتُصاغ كل متطلب في شكل قصة مستخدم تبين النشاط ودور المستخدم («بصفتي…») وما يريد المستخدم أن يقوم به النظام.
narratives.zh: 本表列出了数字化产前保健系统的53项功能性需求（ANC.FXNREQ.001–053），按业务流程A（登记）和B（产前保健接触）分组。每项需求均以用户故事形式表述，列出活动、用户角色（“作为……”）以及该用户希望系统完成的事项。
narratives.es: El cuadro enumera 53 requisitos funcionales (ANC.FXNREQ.001–053) de un sistema digital de atención prenatal, agrupados por proceso operativo A (registro) y B (contacto prenatal). Cada requisito se formula como una historia de usuario que indica la actividad, la función del usuario («Como…») y lo que este desea que haga el sistema.
narratives.fr: Le tableau présente 53 exigences fonctionnelles (ANC.FXNREQ.001–053) d’un système numérique de soins prénatals, regroupées selon le processus opérationnel A (enregistrement) et B (contact prénatal). Chaque exigence est formulée comme un récit utilisateur précisant l’activité, le rôle de l’utilisateur (« En tant que… ») et ce que celui-ci attend du système.
narratives.ru: В таблице перечислены 53 функциональных требования (ANC.FXNREQ.001–053) к цифровой системе дородовой помощи, сгруппированные по рабочим процессам A (регистрация) и B (дородовой контакт). Каждое требование сформулировано как пользовательская история с указанием этапа, роли пользователя («Как…») и того, что пользователь ожидает от системы.

narratives.es: El cuadro enumera 69 requisitos no funcionales (ANC.NFXNREQ.001–069) de un sistema digital de atención prenatal, cada uno con su categoría, que abarcan la seguridad (confidencialidad, autenticación, registro de auditoría, gestión de usuarios) y los requisitos del sistema (generales, escalabilidad, facilidad de uso, configuración, interoperabilidad, equipos y conectividad).
narratives.fr: Le tableau présente 69 exigences non fonctionnelles (ANC.NFXNREQ.001–069) d’un système numérique de soins prénatals, chacune avec sa catégorie : sécurité (confidentialité, authentification, piste d’audit et journaux, gestion des utilisateurs) et exigences du système (générales, évolutivité, convivialité, configuration, interopérabilité, matériel et connectivité).
narratives.ru: В таблице перечислены 69 нефункциональных требований (ANC.NFXNREQ.001–069) к цифровой системе дородовой помощи с указанием категории каждого: безопасность (конфиденциальность, аутентификация, журналы аудита, управление пользователями) и системные требования (общие, масштабируемость, удобство использования, настройка, совместимость, оборудование и связь).
